title: Interpretability of Chain-of-Thought: Do Reasoning Tokens Reflect Internal Computation?
original_idea: Fine-tune GPT-2 Small on a multi-step arithmetic task with explicit reasoning steps. Compare information in residual stream at each CoT token against linear probes predicting intermediate results.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Directly tests whether CoT monitoring is mechanistically grounded. If CoT tokens diverge from internal state, CoT monitoring is unreliable. Critical safety question.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires fine-tuning GPT-2 Small on a custom dataset plus residual stream analysis with linear probes at specific token positions. Fine-tuning setup and dataset creation are time-consuming for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Multiple steps: dataset creation, fine-tuning, probe training, comparison. Scope is broader than it appears.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
